events.name: Beach Day
events.details: Join us for a relaxed day at the Balsamar Beach Club. Come ready for sun, sand, and surf. Please bring a swimwear, sunscreen, and a towel. Lunch and drinks will be available for purchase.

events.name: Night Out
events.details: Join us for a fun night out at the place where we first met! Come dressed to dance and enjoy a taste of the city's nightlife.

events.name: Holy Hour
events.details: Please join us for quiet hour of prayer and reflection at the lake before the festivities begin. All are welcome to join.

events.name: Welcome Cocktail
events.details: Gather with family and friends for a welcome cocktails and local pupusa dinner at Juanpa's family lake home overlooking Lago de Coatepeque. Enjoy some pupusas, drinks, and the company of loved ones as we celebrate the weekend ahead.

events.name: Wedding Ceremony
events.description: Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe
events.details: The heart of the weekend! Please join us as we exchange vows at the Basilica de Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe. Please arrive 30 minutes early to be seated before the ceremony begins. We will provide transportation from the Basilica to the reception at Cajamarca.

events.name: Reception & After Party
events.details: Let the party begin! Please join us to celebrate our marriage and enjoy the night with dinner, dancing, and plenty of surprises await. Formal attire requested. Please look at FAQ for more attire details.

events.name: Farewell Brunch
events.details: For those joining us from out of town, we’d love for you to wrap up the weekend with us over breakfast before heading to the airport. Breakfast is completely optional, but we’d be so happy to have the chance to say goodbye!
